historical_record.description: Habitat for Humanity broke ground here on November 19, 1997 for four three-bedroom condominiums, on a lot acquired from the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency.
Habitat for Humanity San Francisco finished its volunteer-built homes here and handed them over at a ribbon cutting on December 12, 1998.
